items.name: Morepork / Ruru
items.description: Rounded low hoot-like swells; smooth repeated AM, not an exact paired call.

items.name: Sacred Kingfisher / Kōtare
items.description: Dry bright staccato pulses with a short falling edge.

items.name: Silvereye / Tauhou
items.description: Delicate liquid rising line with light flutter; full song grammar remains a design target.

items.name: New Zealand Fantail / Pīwakawaka
items.description: Fine high repeated chatter-like pulses, clipped and lightly rising.

items.name: New Zealand Bellbird / Korimako
items.description: Clean ringing inharmonic modes with upper partials fading faster.

items.name: Grey Warbler / Riroriro
items.description: Thin sustained falling filament with a fast amplitude flutter.

items.name: Tūī
items.description: Ringing core with coarse AM interruptions and a wider falling contour; no cough/noise segments yet.

items.name: Whitehead / Pōpokotea
items.description: Short bright reed chirps opening upwards; two-stage colour phrase remains pending.

items.name: Kākā
items.description: Broad coarse odd-harmonic body, strong amplitude roughness and falling pulsed calls.

items.name: Tomtit / Miromiro
items.description: Compact rounded whistle pulses settling downwards; slowing downscale remains pending.

items.name: Shining Bronze Cuckoo / Pīpīwharauroa
items.description: Pure rising whistled pulses; per-syllable upsweeps and terminal fall remain pending.

items.name: House sparrow
items.description: Compact dry woody chirp pulses with small upward motion; unequal phrase cells remain pending.

items.name: Eurasian blackbird
items.description: Rounded flowing flute-like line with a gentle falling end; no forced immediate repetition.

items.name: European goldfinch
items.description: Light bright finch-family reed with rolling amplitude pulses and a rising contour.

items.name: European greenfinch
items.description: Sustained buzzy finch-family reed, coarse in amplitude and falling slowly.

items.name: Chaffinch
items.description: Crisp finch-family reed rattle with fast pulses and a descending close; acceleration pending.

items.name: Song thrush
items.description: Rounded Turdus whistle with spaced repeated amplitude accents; phrase memory pending.

items.name: Common myna
items.description: Hollow conversational reed with slow declaration-like pulses and coarse amplitude motion.

items.name: Dunnock
items.description: Fine narrow whistle filament with a rising, lightly fluttering line.

items.name: Masked lapwing / spur-winged plover
items.description: Sharp bright clatter-like pulses with a rapid downward burst; no literal rattle recording.

items.name: Canada goose
items.description: Low hollow reed swell with slowly repeated bent accents; group answers remain pending.

items.name: Eurasian / Australian coot
items.description: Compact low wooden pulse with a pinched coarse edge, shorter and drier than swamphen.

items.name: Spotted dove
items.description: Warm low rounded coo-like swells; three-syllable phrase and per-syllable arcs remain pending.

items.name: Little owl
items.description: Single hollow falling owl-like arc, distinct from morepork repeated swells; return bend pending.

items.name: Common starling
items.description: Bright coarse Sturnidae reed with bubbling fast pulses and upward travel; texture montage pending.

items.name: Mallard
items.description: Low compact hollow reed packets with amplitude rasp and a falling envelope; sex is not inferred.

items.name: Australasian swamphen / pūkeko
items.description: Open nasal-inspired coarse reed pulses rising more broadly than compact coot.

items.name: Yellowhammer
items.description: Bright sustained reed with repeated pickups; longer terminal cadence remains pending.

items.name: Common pheasant
items.description: Compact low paired-attack-inspired rough pulses; nonvocal wing flutter is not synthesized here.

items.name: Indian peafowl
items.description: Long open bright reed cries with widely spaced accents and a broad falling slide.

items.name: Lesser redpoll (legacy provider species)
items.description: Fine dry legacy-cabaret finch reed in fast rising packets; exact pairs/triplets remain pending.

items.name: Great white shark
items.description: Slow low diffuse falling tone, an explicit ecological invention; no white-shark calls evidenced.

items.name: Bats - unresolved order fallback
items.description: Neutral generic fallback only. No bat species, echolocation contour or ultrasonic voice is inferred.
